Gaston catches a cold when his cave has a leaky roof, so Holly invites him to stay at the Little Castle until it is fixed. But soon Gaston is taking over, eating the King's food, sitting in his chair and sleeping in his bed.

After battling off Garmadon's Stone Army, the Ninjas finally arrive at the Temple of Light where they harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd who becomes more powerful than he ever imagined.

The University makes George a lucrative job offer in the hopes of recruiting Sheldon. Meanwhile, Georgie gets a job working for Meemaw's new boyfriend, and Mary is determined to rid her home of greed.
Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
Mary takes matters into her own hands and gets Pastor Jeff involved when Sheldon isn't invited to Billy's birthday party. George, meanwhile, has "male-bonding time" with Dr. Sturgis.
This episode: a deep dive into a rhino's mouth, a group reindeer pedicure, a saucy monkey, a cuddly koala, and an afternoon stroll with a vulture.
What do Lego, Olivia Rodrigo, Warrior Cats and Melbourne trams have in common? They're all topics on this episode of Hard Quiz Kids, where four young fans match wits with the hilarious Tom Gleeson!

When Merlin has an unexpected meeting with the mysterious Taliesin, the wizened old sorcerer takes the young warlock to the crystal cave and shows him a glimpse of the future. But this gift turns out to be more of a curse.

Louis and Jessica try to make things right after the restaurant receives a poor review on a website called Phil's Phaves. Meanwhile, Eddie stresses out when the mix tape he made for Alison falls into the wrong hands.
Sheldon starts the first internet flame war, and Missy stands up to the boys on her baseball team. Meanwhile, Meemaw is unhappy when George spends time with her new boyfriend.
Mr Bean drives Mrs Wicket to the hospital for a minor operation, but gets bored waiting and goes for a wander.
Mr Bean is determined to have a go on a kids' fire engine ride in a supermarket.
Stopping in Rinshin Town, our heroes investigate the mystery of a haunted mansion!
Dr Xand invents a crazy game show to put Dr Chris' reactions and reflexes to the test in the lab, and Dr Ronx heads out on call with the emergency services.
Panda gets kidnapped by a pair of deranged French foxes.
When Charlie and Bronwyn take the kids on a sailing lesson, Charlie feels upstaged by Peter and a seagull. As Charlie tries to win back the kids' attention, he ends up sinking the boat.
Nikhil and Jay are drawing a comic together, but Jay thinks Nikhil is much better than him so decides to retire from drawing!
When Nine needs a helping hand, he turns into a talented trio of circus blocks, the Three Threes. Learn how to share 9 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.
As well as coping with some strange long grass, Nim makes a lion picture, bakes a popcorn sheep, and creates a cactus costume with the Crafty Kids' help.

p.t: Thomas And Friends: Big World! Big Adventures!
p.d: When Kenji hears that he must travel home to Japan alone, he gets scared and tries to hide. So, Thomas sets out to find him.

Today Peppa and George are painting. Daddy shows Peppa and George how to mix paints and the three of them paint a beautiful picture of a cherry tree in the garden. Everything is going very well, until the ducks turn up!

Grandpa Pig has built a little train and takes Peppa and George for a ride. Along the way they meet their friends and there's room for everyone aboard. Peppa and George think it's the best train in the whole world!
Elsbeth is having a tantrum and scaring the little creatures of the forest, so Kiri finds a clever way of calming her down.
When one of the Baby Pea-Rexes gets the hiccups, Ginger and the other two try all manner of cures to get rid of them.

A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle. The party is full of wonderful surprises and Granpapa shows everyone his funny hobbies.
Zigzag's buddy doesn't feel like coming out to play. Vida gets him up, exercising, and healthy!
When a gold statue goes missing, the Heroes think a shadowy figure's behind it, only to discover it's Shade, a new hero.
The crew must team up with the fabled tooth mouse El Ratoncito Perez to retrieve his stolen cap and satchel from Enrique.
To get his ship back from Octobella, Pirate Robot becomes the captain of the PJMs. But can he be a good captain?
When the Octonauts discover a pod of Beluga Whales stranded at a breathing hole, they use music to lead them to safety.
Each Squirrel is struggling to master a new skill but instead of giving up, Duggee teaches them that if at first you don't succeed, try again!

It's the day of the big Kangaroo Beach beach cricket match, but when Gemma and the cadets find a nest of turtle eggs, they play 'parents', vowing to protect the eggs from seagulls, crabs and flying cricket balls.
When Charlie and Bronwyn take the kids on a sailing lesson, Charlie feels upstaged by Peter and a seagull. As Charlie tries to win back the kids' attention, he ends up sinking the boat.
Nikhil and Jay are drawing a comic together, but Jay thinks Nikhil is much better than him so decides to retire from drawing!
When Charlie and Bronwyn take the kids on a sailing lesson, Charlie feels upstaged by Peter and a seagull. As Charlie tries to win back the kids' attention, he ends up sinking the boat.
Nikhil and Jay are drawing a comic together, but Jay thinks Nikhil is much better than him so decides to retire from drawing!
When Nine needs a helping hand, he turns into a talented trio of circus blocks, the Three Threes. Learn how to share 9 into equal parts with the Numberblocks.
As well as coping with some strange long grass, Nim makes a lion picture, bakes a popcorn sheep, and creates a cactus costume with the Crafty Kids' help.

You need only your imagination to have fun in a garden. The kids are assigned a list of garden tasks to receive clues and riddles to get to the next stage. From identifying plants to making compost tea, this is a magical exploration with Hannah.

Join Abi and Teo to learn all about moving machines! They work together to dig a hole in the road and move an entire house from the city to the country. Kiya and Little Ted help Humpty build a plane to visit Pa Humpty!
The Wiggles enjoy the sunshine with 'The Ants Are Marching' and Simon plans a picnic. Create colourful collages in Lucia's Craft Corner, and finish with a live performance of 'Here Comes a Bear'.
Fizzy and Suds take us for a ride on a giant radio telescope and discover the Emu Constellation. Let's learn about space together!
DeeDee and Collins need to count a dragonfly's wings so that DeeDee can finish her painting, but L'il Chompy keeps scaring the dragonflies away with his noisy play.
A young Broccoliosaurus isn't tall enough to reach the delicious blooming flowers high in the trees until Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes come up with an ingenious way to get to them.
Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to North America in search of a river chub that builds an underwater nest with over 7,000 pebbles.
Tomas accidentally turns Abuelo into a chicken!
Sparks learns to share his upset feelings.

Duggee's not well, he's lost his voice. The squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the squirrels don't quite understand so they ask all the other animals for advice.
Mum bans the girls from saying the word 'dunny' because it's not a word The Queen would use, but the kids try and trick her into saying it anyway.

A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner begs Chris to find a way to stop the execution.

Honey the spoodle leapt from a car doing 40 km/h to chase a cat. She survived, but how bad are her injuries? Owner Ilana's riddled with guilt for not strapping her in—and wait till you see Honey's reaction when she hears cats out the back.
Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan's horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash, but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.
Chris is confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. A young girl's much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive tumour. But surgery on such a small patient is a challenge.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

Observe as Chris treats Pearl, a poodle that began bleeding internally at the groomer, while surgeons try to save Zoe, a cat that dove off a second-floor balcony. Meanwhile, the clinic gets a special gift from a grateful patient.

Join the team’s 24-hour vigil for Lucu, a pup that’s been bitten by a tick. Then check out Jonti, a cat with a gaping hole in his neck that’s scarily close to his jugular vein—all while Chris tangles with an evasive lame emu.
A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer? And will she ever be able to fly?

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

S30 E13 — Set In His WaysA repeat offender runs when officers catch him. Two teens are slow to stop a bike thief, so police are called to assist. Tensions rise after a questionable room-mate situation takes a dark turn.
An LAPD officer discovers a police task force is harbouring a horrific secret that endangers residents of the housing projects he grew up in.

A masked maniac with glowing, red eyes returns every Valentine's Day to slaughter unsuspecting couples. When a cynical ad executive and her hopelessly romantic colleague become the next target, they decide to fight back and end the reign of terror.
Maya squares off against the masked killers one last time in a brutal, full-circle reckoning of survival and revenge.

On the eve of the 2002 FIFA World Cup, the Irish captain Roy Keane forfeits his place in the squad at the team's preparation base in Saipan, following a heated disagreement with the Irish manager Mick McCarthy.

Four years after her last encounter with Michael Myers, Laurie Strode finally decides to liberate herself and embrace life. However, a local murder unleashes a cascade of violence and terror that forces her to confront the evil she can't control.
Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.

A wealthy businessman Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

p.t: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
p.d: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.
Thrown together under tragic circumstances, three generations of women from the same family are forced to learn to live together on a small rural chicken farm in New Jersey.

Quarterback Cameron Cade trains at an isolated compound with his hero, Isaiah White. As training progresses, Isaiah's charisma turns into something darker, sending Cam down a disorienting rabbit hole that may cost him more than he ever bargained for.

A shark-obsessed serial killer holds Zephyr, a rebellious surfer, captive on his boat. Racing against time, she must figure out a way to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

Convinced his wife is trapped inside, a soldier infiltrates a high-tech facility where reality and illusion blur in a surreal, futuristic fantasy park. As he navigates this seductive and dangerous world, a shocking truth pulls him into a deadly game.

Workaholic assassin Hutch Mansell takes his family on a much-needed holiday to the small tourist town of Plummerville. However, he soon finds himself in the crosshairs of a corrupt theme-park operator, a shady sheriff, and a bloodthirsty crime boss.

Lawman Frank Bennett uncovers a massive smuggling operation after a deadly confrontation. Cut off from cell service and without his truck, he's forced to take on a dangerous gang led by a deranged ex-military commander.
Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome and wealthy Mr Darcy, leading to the beginning of a convoluted courtship between the pair.
Billionaire Christian Grey and new wife Anastasia fully embrace their unwavering connection, until sinister events start to jeopardise their happy ending before it even begins.

After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. As forces conspire to separate the unlikely newlyweds, they must decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.
Five high school students learn about themselves and one another when they are forced to spend a Saturday in detention.

A man and his ex-wife race to Bali, Indonesia, to stop their daughter from marrying a seaweed farmer. As they desperately try to sabotage the wedding, the bickering duo soon find themselves falling for each other once more.
After a one-night stand, a couple decide to get married. However, it turns out to be a rocky road when both parties have to compromise their own cultural traditions.
A 19th-century Russian aristocrat faces a difficult decision when her husband finds out about her scandalous affair with a dashing cavalry officer.

Lt. Callie Jackson returns home after a military tour to find her late grandfather's barbecue joint is struggling, but she has a run-in with a TV director who teaches her that sometimes it's best to look forward instead of looking back.
Billionaire Christian Grey and new wife Anastasia fully embrace their unwavering connection, until sinister events start to jeopardise their happy ending before it even begins.

Gwen and Eddie are America's Sweethearts. The country's favourite couple, on-screen and off, but when their very public romance turns into a very private break-up, only veteran press agent Lee and Gwen's assistant, Kiki, can help Gwen and Eddie show some love while they promote their last film together. The press junket is in a resort hotel miles from anywhere, and while Lee and Kiki frantically try to keep the media away from the real story, Kiki finds something entirely unexpected.

While pursuing the most popular girl in school, an artsy outcast gets some help from his tomboy best friend, who has a crush of her own.
A troubled guy, who is nonetheless a very gifted dancer, attracts the attention of a talented ballerina at a Maryland school, and soon sparks fly between them.
An ultra-cool, fresh out of Detroit, foul-mouthed detective is treading on toes in Beverly Hills as he zeroes in on the scum who killed his friend.

When the Primm family moves to New York City, their young son Josh struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he discovers Lyle, a singing crocodile living in their attic.
Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating a highly skilled international rogue organisation that is committed to destroying the IMF.
Five high school students meet in Saturday detention and discover how they have a great deal more in common than they thought.

When a mysterious woman named Cipher forces Dom to betray his crew, the globetrotting team faces an unexpected challenge. Now they must unite to bring home the man who made them a family and stop her from unleashing chaos on a grand scale.
A spy is on a mission to disprove false accusations made against him by the very government organisation that he works for.
When Eddie Brock acquires the powers of a symbiote, he will have to release his alter-ego \"Venom\" to save his life.
At 17, Finn struggles with life after captivity, while his sister dreams of calls from the black phone and visions of three boys stalked at a winter camp called Alpine Lake.
Anastasia and Christian have settled into a life together, but lingering demons from Christian's past threaten to disrupt their happily ever after.
When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted.
As war rages in Europe, a Nazi-scalping squad of American soldiers, known to their enemy as The Basterds, is on a daring mission to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.
After falling out of a shopping cart, our hero sausage and his new friends embark on a perilous journey through the supermarket to discover the truth about their existence!
Legendary monster hunter Van Helsing must rely on the help of the beautiful and mysterious Anna Valeris as he engages in an epic battle with the ultimate forces of darkness.
The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organisation's name.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Bringing it Home
p.d: S1 E7Episode 7 of Just Getting Started covers the thrilling UCI race at Mont Sainte-Anne. The Norco Race Division team celebrated an amazing finish, with Gracey's top performance, Greg's strong UCI career finale, and Kirk's impressive 16th place. A weekend of passion, home support, and racing history!

Before fatherhood, Australian surfer/filmmaker/musician Nick Colbey takes one last must-do trip. The Buckety is self-shot, self-narrated and self-scored as he chases dream waves from Hawaii to South Africa, then the UK and Ireland-through missed flights, wipeouts and kind strangers. Less performance, more presence.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Transkei
p.d: S3 E9Having grown up in South Africa before the fall of apartheid, Pottz is very cautious about all the driving the crew is doing. At one time the Transkei had been like its own country,and travel through it was incredibly dangerous. So when the crew  gets on the way to the next stop, Pottz is less than happy. Arrival at Coffee Bay meant safety and security to the crew and a chance at scoring yet another great point break.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Wild Coast
p.d: S3 E10The crew arrives in Coffee Bay at another hostile-like sleeping situation: A small camp set up by traveling surfers at one of South Africa's less accessible surfing areas. No signs and no roads make it hard for travelers to get to the spots. After breakfast and changing yet another flat tire, the crew makes it down to the beach and a small yet perfect right point. Pottz waits patiently on the beach because of a shark sighting when they arrive, as well as a story of an Australian surfer getting eaten whole just at the tip of the point.
S1 E2This episode finds Shayne and Shannon surfing the perfect waves of Bocas Del Toro, giving much insight into the amazing culture and running into top pro surfer friends.

S1 E3Shannon and Shayne venture deep into the vast Indian Ocean in search of the most perfect wave in the world, the surreal Tamarin Bay.  While there they try to re-capture Shayne's experiences of being raised there in the 70's by his surf-hippy parents, and Shannon contemplates her soon to be born first child.

Jump in the van and ride shotgun with this crew of snowboarders (and the token skier) as they explore Hokkaido's resorts, backcountry and culture. Witness the neck-deep powder, wild nights and other-worldly experiences that only Japan can provide.

It's hard to know what's haunting the Cumberland Library and Monastery in Rhode Island. It could be nine settlers who were skinned alive and buried there in the 1600s. Or it could be the inhabitants of a monastery used for generations. Currently a library, people report voices, doors opening and slamming, and shadowy, floating monks around the property. Adam and Amy encounter something that turns the faucets on and off in a bathroom.

TAPS travels to Brunswick, Ga., to investigate the Brunswick Old City Hall, where an officer was killed in the 1890s; next, the team heads to a former worsted mill, where the caretaker is on edge and insists that the location be kept a secret.

The TAPS team explore an abandoned school in Barnegat, N.J., looking into reports that the apparition of a beloved teacher who died in 1965 is luring children inside the building. Later, they arrive in Clay County, Fla., on a mission to discover if an old courthouse and jail is haunted by the ghosts of inmates and a murdered sheriff.

TAPS return to the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum in Weston, West Virginia, for their 200th episode, which finds the team reunited with Grant, Dustin and Joe. Efforts are made to reach former patients who suffered tragic lives in the hospital.
TAPS visits Cincinnati Music Hall on Halloween to uncover whether the thousands of people buried under the building are playing paranormal tricks.
Some new, and old cast members participate in the investigation of the Wild Turkey Distillery in Kentucky. The TAPS team looks for traces of the ghosts of the founding family members.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to New York to investigate unexplained activity at the Culinary Institute of America, where many believe the spirits of Jesuit priests roam the area where they once lived when the institute was once a seminary.
To set a bride-to-be's mind at ease, TAPS checks out the venue where her wedding will be held. Then, the team examines a Connecticut mansion.
TAPS travels to the historic St. Charles, Missouri to investigate Main Street’s hauntings.

The team investigate the Burlingame and Chaffee Opera House in Carthage, Mo.; and they visit a private residence in Connecticut to help a family who believe a presence has taken over their home and children.

TAPS travel to Missouri to help three generations of a family living on what they believe to be a haunted estate; and in Massachusetts, the team investigate whether one ghost is connected to two different properties.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to Rhode Island to help owners of two allegedly haunted theaters investigate two buildings to learn if the spirits that are possibly occupying the second building is traveling between the two locations.

TAPS investigates Fort Adams in Newport, RI where the caretaker says visitors are jabbed and have rocks thrown at them. He's hoping the team can determine who the spirits are and what ear they come from. The investigators have numerous experiences including hearing footsteps; K.J. is twice touched at two different locations. Their recorders also pick up knocking sounds and a child's ghostly voice.
TAPS examines the Houghton Mansion in Massachusetts, where a tragic 1914 car crash that claimed four lives may have left restless spirits behind.

TAPS investigates at Southern Vermont College in Bennington. According to legend, the wife of the school's founder committed suicide when learning about his affair with the nanny, who, it's said, hanged herself. Witnesses report a white mist in the library, as well as voices and self-opening windows. Orbs and voices are also reported in a nearby dorm. The team collects evidence they believe points to a residual haunting.

Scott Beck’s life hasn’t gone to plan. Now a high school janitor where he was once a basketball star, he faces family struggles and old regrets. When his former love Ryan holds open tryouts for her team, Scott sees a chance to chase his dream.

Comedy All-Stars brings together a lineup of hilarious, family-friendly comedians for a night of clean, feel-good laughter. Featuring top talent who prove you don’t need crude jokes to be funny, this series delivers quick wit, clever humour, and plenty of joy. From laugh-out-loud stand-up to relatable storytelling, Comedy All-Stars is the perfect reminder that a good laugh really is the best medicine - and it’s even better when you can share it with the whole family.

Whirl is a Bible-based cartoon series about the loveable, sometimes overly-enthusiastic kids of First Second Church. In each episode, the kids tackle a different theme that is central to Christian values. Everything from generosity and forgiveness to doubt and the trinity are explored over the course of the series. And while the issues dealt with in each episode are relatable, the solutions this kooky cast often find are a bit… unconventional. Whether the kids of First Second Church are searching for a hidden sanctum of the church's altar guild, or trying to outsmart robots bent on world domination, these characters will keep the whole family laughing and learning.

An action-packed, award-winning animated series featuring real-life heroes of the faith. Aimed at children from ages 8 to 12, the series highlights the honour, integrity and life-changing experiences of those well-known and little-known Christian men, women and children who, in response to God's call, dedicated themselves to a life of whole-hearted commitment and passionate service to Jesus. Heroes, or 'Torchlighters' featured include William Tyndale, Perpetua, Jim Elliot, Amy Carmichael, Gladys Aylward, John Bunyan, Richard Wurmbrand, Eric Liddell and more.

Discover how similar we are to our faith ancestors from the Old Testament. These hilarious animations reveal more about Bible heroes, villains, and everyday folks that God selected to do extraordinary things.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.
This week, we once again put on our purple shirts with Revesby Workers Club and continue through the Helping Hands Domestic Violence Study Guide.
Sarah Drew, Patricia Heaton and Sean Astin star in this comedy about three mothers seeking a night off who get caught in chaos with lost babies, swapped cars, and a surprise police visit.

The long trek down the West Australian coastline begins. Endless beaches and fiery red sands match the sun setting sky. Nick discovers faith in the Pilbara and gets some sage-like advice from a spiritual father.
A new direction brings fresh struggles as Gary puts his investigative talents to use. A new assistant brings a unique perspective to the workplace.

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

Hosted by the Hembree family, Bible Discovery TV is a thirty-minute daily devotional show where Rod, Janice, Ryan and Corie walk you through the Word in a way that will forever change how you read, learn and experience the Bible.
Join Pastor Steven in the Basin where he digs deep into scripture and breaks down the Word of God in these short conversational teachings.

Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says \.

In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Twenty aspiring chefs divide into teams of men and women and try to impress Chef Gordon Ramsay with their signature dish; the winning team gets to sit down to dinner with Ramsay while the losers are left to clean up the kitchen.

The contestants go on an unexpected field trip to a Gordon Ramsay restaurant so that they can see what they have to look forward to, then the teams prepare meals from the restaurant's menu, and while one excels, another struggles to communicate.

The team with the best knowledge of pork goes indoor sky-diving while the losing team prepares for dinner service, but while one team has a hard time dividing responsibilities, the other can't coordinate timing, leaving dinner service a disaster.

The contestants blindly choose ingredients in a dark grocery store and must create a dish that uses all of them; the contestants struggle to serve a five-course meal to VIP attendees, including UNICEF ambassador Angie Harmon.

The Mythbusters begin this episode by once again taking aim at a classic movie myth. Can you really be Blown Away in a gunfight?

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie go head to head in a madcap Mexican jailbreak jaunt. And brace yourselves for the biggest bang ever on Mythbusters - by a mile - when Adam, Jamie and 850 pounds of high explosive join forces with the FBI to wreak their revenge on a stubborn cement truck.
In the myth a car breaks its drive shaft at the front universal joint. The drive shaft drops into a pothole and lifts the car into the air – much like a pole vault.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie try a test with a ton of toast, the build team head up a myth that’s one big yawn, and the whole gang decamp to Lake Tahoe for the most mismatched motor car race of all time.

This episode of MythBusters answers three diverse questions. Those with an eye for history will learn whether or not a crude form of battery was invented more than 2000 years ago. Those interested in technology will learn how to rebuild a crash test dummy. And everybody else will learn the fastest way to cool a six-pack of beer.

Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen, and make the woman pregnant? Can a boat be driven with its trailer still attached?

The build team are testing out a story that could bring every household to its knees! Can the humble vacuum cleaner beloved by housewives and husbands for over 100 years, be turned into something altogether more terrifying?

In this twin-taled episode, Adam and Jamie embark on the longest and most ambitious build ever undertaken on Mythbusters. The sky is literally the limit as they aim to take wing on their own personal flying machine, which they knock up from scratch in the workshop. Meanwhile, Kari, Tory and Scotty subject an ancient myth to some modern testing - do pyramids have mystical powers of preservation?
Myth has it that when your plane's going down and the flight attendant tells you to assume the brace position, it's not to save you...it's to kill you!

In this special episode, the Mythbusters get into the festive spirit. They tackle a series of brand new Christmas myths, and in a first for the program, re-show the viewers' all time favourite experiments, as voted for on the Discovery Channel website.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie hurl themselves headlong into a crazy contemporary myth, and bag a world record into the bargain. With nothing less than the very security of America's borders at stake, they dedicate an entire show to a myth which involves one of their biggest ever builds.

In this episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam tackle yet another automotive myth head-on and we mean head-on. They’ve got a car, Buster and a box of tissues. Sounds like a recipe for disaster. In the episode’s other story, the build team try to bust a myth from the middle ages, using an arrow-firing robot. It’s just another day in the MythBusters’ madhouse.

In this episode of MythBusters, Jamie, Adam and the team are in aviation heaven with three tall tales of high flying and free falling. The first pits them against Hollywood logic with Buster doing his best Indiana Jones impression. The second tests the explosive properties and decapitation potential of Hair Cream. And the third is about surviving a fall from 33,000 feet without a parachute.
In this episode, Adam and Jamie take their detractors head on as they revisit some of their favourite myths. They're going to answer them once and for all and forever silence their critics!

In this episode of Mythbusters, we could find out that pride comes before a fall. The same myth leads Adam to pit his mouth against a dog’s in a “who would you like to kiss most?” contest. Confused? You won’t be. It all makes perfect sense. In the reality that is the Mythbusters’ at least.

Jessica wants to know if her boyfriend Sirod secretly fathered a child with a woman named Amber. And later, Danielle has been told by her mother Teresa that Paul is her father, but Paul has always denied it.

Ray Ray is convinced that her fiance DJ is cheating on her. Instead of planning her wedding, she has been conducting her own private investigations. Then, every time Jerrica suspects that her husband is cheating, they pack up and move.

In a special series, Trisha Uncut, meet Greg, an aspiring rapper who wants 27 children of different ethnicities with 9 different women. His girlfriend Nicole is three months pregnant and wants to know if he's cheating with groupies.

Melissa claims that her teen sister Alexis has been promiscuous, stealing, and doing drugs and blames their absentee mom. Then, Rhonda turns to Trisha to help rein in her pregnant daughter Shiane from doing drugs and sleeping around!
Danielle found Joshua on dating sites; Lorita found Chris in boxers with her sister nearby.

Capria suspects that her boyfriend Corteze has been messing around with her sister. Then, before she agrees to marry him, LaTisha is demanding that her fiancé Anthony take a lie detector exam to prove that he has not cheated.

They're back! Nadia and Nina hadn't spoken to each other in four years because Nadia was accused of sleeping with Nina's husband before he died. The lie detector proved Nadia's innocence. So were the sisters able to mend their relationship?

Champ denies he is the father of Twyla's son, but she discovered on Facebook that he also denies a 10-month-old baby girl by a woman named Princess. Capria suspects her boyfriend Corteze has been messing around with her sister.

Barbie suspects that her boyfriend Jose has been cheating. Barbie says she can’t ignore the signs any longer and today she wants to know the truth! And later, Jenn says Eddie needs to act his age and stop denying their child.

Chris and his girlfriend Helena, believe that his ex-girlfriend Scottie is trying to pin another man’s baby on him. Then, Lillian is determined to prove to the man she loves that she’s been faithful and more importantly that he’s the father.

Tina is desperate to determine which one of these brothers, Michael or Don Don, is the father of her son. Then, Craig Cobb, white supremacist and social commentator, Shahrazad Ali return to the show and agree to take an ancestry DNA test.

Daric denies he is the father of Sarah's baby because he was only intimate with her one time. Later, Candice is desperate to prove to her husband Sam that she has not cheated on him and that her kids are in-fact his.
Paige says Richard fathered her kids; Ashley, 13, says Jimmy's the dad, but he doubts it.

Juice is here to reveal to Jessica that he’s a woman. Jolene has been sleeping with her sister’s girlfriend, Stephanie! Chante doesn’t approve of her sister’s fiancée and won’t hold her peace at their wedding!
Solo has a few things he needs to tell his best friend and girlfriend, Vixen.

At the start of day nine on the water, last season's champion, captain Greg Mayer and his Fishin' Frenzy crew are the top earners the Outer Banks' Bluefin tuna fleet. But their lead is only a slim margin over local rivals Charlie and Jake Griffin, of father-and-son operation Reels of Fortune. The Griffin boys, with a $10,000 boat repair bill still hanging over their heads, are more desperate than ever for a payday. Meanwhile, Captain TJ Ott, of northern boat Hot tuna, is looking for any advantage he can get to turn his mediocre season around, so he reaches out to southern Captain Tami Gray, of all-female team Reel Action, hoping that a new friendship will lead to a wealth of local knowledge. And on Doghouse, Captain Britton Shackelford's chances of landing his second keeper tuna of the season will all come down to whether his greenhorn son Austin can come through in a dangerous situation.

Eleven days into North Carolina's Bluefin tuna season, treacherous winter weather in the Outer Banks fishing grounds forces captains to push their limits. Southern boat Reels of Fortune holds a meager lead over last year's local champion Fishin' Frenzy, while northern boat Hard Merchandise and local all-female team Reel Action have yet to catch a fish.
A crewmember faces a family emergency unfolding on land that tests his resolve on the water.

Charlie Griffin, captain of family operation Reels of Fortune, and Greg Mayer, skipper of last season's top?earning boat Fishin' Frenzy, are neck and neck in the competition for the number one spot in the fleet. Meanwhile struggling Northern vessels Hot Tuna, who has caught only one bluefin so far, and Hard Merchandise, who have yet to land their first fish in southern waters, are desperate to make a paycheck in the Outer Banks. But soon one Northern boat will harvest the biggest fish so far this season.

With less than two weeks left in the North Carolina's Outer Banks Bluefin tuna season, time is disappearing for the fleet, and so are the fish. The captains and their crews are desperate for some final catches, but with the Bluefin starting their annual migration to other waters, these last few days of fishing will be make-or-break.

In North Carolina, the Outer Banks Bluefin tuna fishing season will soon be coming to a close. Southern boats Reels of Fortune, Fishin' Frenzy and Doghouse have emerged as the frontrunners this season. Northern vessels Hot Tuna and Pinwheel, and local all-female trio Reel Action have all struggled to catch and languish far behind on the leaderboard. Now, with only five days left to fish, the pressure is palpable, pitting boat against boat and on one troubled vessel, captain against crew.

With only two days of fishing left in North Carolina's Outer Banks Bluefin tuna season, southern boats Reels of Fortune and Fishin' Frenzy are running neck-and-neck for the top spot, with less than $200 separating the two rivals. However, one or two good Bluefin could also catapult fellow local boat Doghouse to the top of the leaderboard. Meanwhile, with only two fish each for northern boats Hot Tuna and Pinwheel, and only one fish for southern female trio Reel Action, these three boats are desperate for a final paycheck before the season closes.
The bluefin tuna arrive in North Carolina's treacherous Outer Banks much earlier than expected, leaving the fleet scrambling to get on the water.
As the new season takes off, the treacherous waters of the Outer Banks, known as the Graveyard of the Atlantic, claim more victims.

It's early in the Outer Banks bluefin tuna season, but it's already obvious that even an experienced fisherman might not have what it takes to survive in this hyper-competitive fishery. The animosity between southern and northern boats reaches a fever pitch, while the longstanding rivalry between two southern boats raises the stakes for the whole fleet.
An underdog captain takes a stand against the cocky reigning champion who underestimates him, forcing the fleet to take notice.
For a third season, National Geographic Channel's Wicked Tuna: Outer Banks returns to the most dangerous place in the world to catch tuna.

It's the halfway point of bluefin tuna fishing season in North Carolina's Outer Banks, and for the fishermen chasing big paydays on the water, the race is on against the clock, as well as each other. With the top four boats all close in the earnings and the top spot in the fleet up for grabs, the pressure's mounting on everyone to make some money and prove they've got what it takes to be the best.

Winter kicks into high gear in the Outer Banks and dangerous conditions at sea, including a snowstorm, fog, fierce winds and big seas, force every captain to decide whether to play it safe at the dock or risk it all and brave the weather in a bid to catch bluefin. With limited weather windows, the constant challenge for the fleet is whether or not they can get out to the fishing grounds, have enough time to fish, and then get back in safely before the next big weather system hits.

Another season is rapidly disappearing and it's make-?or-?break time for the Outer Banks captains. With only 8 days of fishing left, the crews are desperate to produce a few last catches that will make all the difference in winning or losing - and making a living.
